title: org-hiring-loop-playbook-draft
content:
Meeting prep scratchpad: HC sync / interview loop playbook (notes to self)

Context:
- Weekly HC sync with Selena (VP Eng) + finance check. Goal: align Q2 hiring cadence, firm up interview loop for infra/serving-runtime hires, and agree fallback plan if budget changes.
- Current ask: 8 net new roles across Eng + SRE (4 infra, 2 serving runtime, 1 sre, 1 devtools). Need prioritization and concrete schedule.

Primary goals for the sync (what I want out of this meeting):
- Get buy-in on the priority order (1: serving-runtime backend, 2: infra GPU scheduler, 3: SRE, 4: devtools)
- Confirm hiring cadence: staggered offers across April-July vs. all-in ramp in May
- Approve interview loop for infra/serving candidates + hiring scorecard template
- Identify any finance constraints that would force shift to contractors or slower ramp

Agenda (5–10m per item; total 30–35m):
1) Quick status (2m): current open reqs, candidates in pipeline, time-to-offer baseline.
2) Prioritization ask (7m): why serving-runtime first (latency regressions + Q2 infra work).
3) Interview loop proposal (10m): show loop, time per stage, interviewer pool, decision SLAs.
4) Headcount phasing + budget check (8m): proposed months for offers, potential cost delta.
5) Next steps / owners (3m).

Interview loop (draft, notes):
- Stage 0: Recruiter screen (30m) — evaluate culture fit, salary expectations, basic resume sanity check.
- Stage 1: Hiring manager technical screen (45m) — system design + past infra work; prioritize questions about serving runtimes/quantization tradeoffs for infra hires.
- Stage 2a: Deep technical take-home (optional for senior candidates) — 6–8 hour exercise; focus prompt on optimizing KV cache / batching for throughput.
- Stage 2b: Coding session (60m) — pair-programming; small tasks but focused on performance and memory tradeoffs.
- Stage 3: Cross-team panel (60m) — 2 engineers (serving runtime), 1 SRE, 1 product/PM (impact conversation).
- Stage 4: Exec/leadership final (30m) — alignment on scope and expectations.
- Debrief: hiring manager fills scorecard within 24 hours; panelists submit feedback in Greenhouse within 48 hours.

Scorecard (quick template items):
- System design: 1–5
- Coding: 1–5
- Operational awareness (SLOs, observability): 1–5
- Team fit / collaboration: 1–5
- Impact potential / speed of onboarding: 1–5
- Compensation / risk flag: free text

Open questions / risks to raise in the meeting:
- Finance: any hard hiring freeze triggers for May? (ask Selena to confirm thresholds)
- Onboarding capacity: can infra team absorb 3 hires in June without a dedicated mentor? Need to ask Eng L&D or allocate buddy time.
- Interviewer bandwidth: we currently have 6 potential interviewers; if we double pipeline we need 2 more interviewers or risk >2 week delays.
- Candidate pipeline health: for senior infra roles, current pipeline is thin — may need to engage agency or extend referral bonus.

Fallbacks and contingency plans:
- If budget constrained: convert 2 roles to 6-month contractor FTEs (priority: devtools, SRE as contractor first).
- Slow ramp: hire 3 now, defer rest to Q3; accelerate external agency in parallel.
- Internal reorg: consider lateral transfers from platform engineering for short-term capacity (requires manager approvals).

Action items to propose during sync (owner / ETA):
- Confirm priority list and phasing with Selena (Owner: Selena / ETA: 2026-03-18)
- Approve interview loop + scorecard (Owner: Omar / ETA: 2026-03-20)
- Ask Finance for top-line commit threshold and potential temporary hiring cap (Owner: Selena / ETA: 2026-03-19)
- Recruiter to push 10 new outreach messages for senior infra by EOD Friday (Owner: Sofia / ETA: 2026-03-13)
- Identify two additional interviewers from serving-runtime (Owner: Hiring manager — Raj / ETA: 2026-03-22)

Notes-to-self / messaging snippets (for the sync):
- "We want predictable ramp, not a firehose. Prioritizing serving-runtime yields fastest ROI because it reduces cost/perf regressions across hosted API."
- "If finance prefers a slower spend profile, I'm recommending contractor conversions for the lower-priority roles — keeps momentum on core infra."
- "Short-term interviewer capacity will be the gating factor; suggest blocking 2 afternoons/week for interview squads."

Quick budget back-of-envelope (ballpark):
- Avg fully-burdened hire cost (eng senior): $280k/year -> monthly ~23k. 8 hires = ~1.84M/year additional run rate.
- Contractors (6-month) estimate: $120–160/hr -> 6 months per role ~150k.

Debrief template (post-hire):
- 1-week: onboarding checklist completed? mentor assigned?
- 30-day: shipping initial bugfix/visibility in telemetry?
- 90-day: ownership in project, measurable perf improvements or migrated workloads.

Follow-ups I need to do after the sync (my personal TODO):
- Draft final loop doc and push into Confluence + Greenhouse templates (Omar — due 2026-03-20).
- Create interview slot calendar invites for next two weeks (Temp interview squad blocks).
- Run quick calibration session with interviewers after first two onsites (to keep scoring aligned).

Loose ideas / experimentation (brainstorm):
- Try a 2-stage fast path for senior ICs: manager screen -> panel -> offer in 7–10 days (for critical hires).
- Small coding kata focusing on memory management for quantized models (good for infra role).
- Build short checklist for hiring manager to estimate onboarding capacity before req approval.

Unresolved / parking lot:
- Final comp bands for senior infra (need compensation input).
- Legal checks for contractor vs full-time in EU (ask legal).

End of scratchpad. Will tidy to final playbook if Selena okays priorities.

---
Last line: reminder to myself: breathe. this is a planning doc not a launch manifesto.
